references.text: The original description of the bronze altar with its grating and carrying poles, mentioned here in 35:16.
The description of how the bronze altar was actually made, including its grating and carrying poles.
The original instruction to make the bronze basin (kijjor) with its stand for the priests' ritual washings.
The description of how the bronze basin and its stand were actually made.
The instruction to place the bronze altar and the bronze basin in the tabernacle.
The completion of the work where Moses sets up the bronze altar and the bronze basin.
The use of the bronze altar in connection with sacrifices.
Confirms the fulfillment of the earlier command; shows that the work was carried out in full accordance with God's specific instructions.
Connects the command and its execution with a specific detail about the source of the material (bronze from offerings), enriching the understanding of the altar's holy origin.
